description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog brands in an e-commerce application. It uses ASP.NET Core minimal APIs, AutoMapper for object mapping, and interacts with a repository interface to fetch CatalogBrand entities, returning the data in a structured response.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class responsible for handling HTTP GET requests to list catalog brands, utilizing dependency injection, and mapping entities to DTOs.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the GET request 'api/catalog-brands' and binds it to the handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by fetching catalog brand entities from the repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the response.
